Could we rename this group from Shapella -> Dencun and shapella-public to dencun-public? https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/pull/81/files updates Nethermind's image for anyone interested: nethermindeth/nethermind:eip-4844-v5 Deploying it now. `ssh devops@lodestar-nethermind-1.srv.4844-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io` <@792822129019584562> looks like lodestar is having some issues peering up with the bootnode. Might be a nethermind issue actually, as looks like it can sync up easily to slot 280, then it stops syncing. ```Apr-25 09:08:59.151[chain] error: Block error slot=280 code=BLOCK_ERROR_EXECUTION_ERROR, execStatus=INVALID, errorMessage=Block 267 (0x442ce15c5dec3e74f4753ba24730e76d0f52f174e827d42884d43a2ab0843141) could not be parsed as a block Error: BLOCK_ERROR_EXECUTION_ERROR``` Thanks for the starting it up! I'm checking the logs too Could you share a node with some synced EL plz? I need to query blocks to compare there is ethereumjs node running, <@412614104222531604> may be a good idea to also spin up 1 lodestar<>erigon independently as well, since erigon was also able to sync ok Do you have our nginx basic auth pass? You could use this as an rpc endpoint with basic auth `https://rpc.bootnode-1.srv.4844-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io` this need not have the validator in our current ongoing test run since anyway erigon need some fixes for getpayloadv3 give me a couple mins, and I'll spin one more up Looks like no done ssh name? <@412614104222531604> `g11tech/lodestar:blobs-2467` is the fresher lodestar image you may use for further installs `ssh devops@lodestar-erigon-1.srv.4844-devnet-5.ethpandaops.io` updating the lodestar img looks synced erigon<>lodestar <@792822129019584562> what BLOCK_ERROR_PARENT_UNKNOWN may mean? We are syncing with lodestar, but it's being interrupted from time to time with this message ``` Apr-25 11:48:34.977[chain] error: Block error slot=3392 code=BLOCK_ERROR_PARENT_UNKNOWN, parentRoot=0x4669ca5aa1b0def102a568ee217338596f5fa4b0059f73a462fbebcada634835 Error: BLOCK_ERROR_PARENT_UNKNOWN at verifyBlocksSanityChecks (file:///usr/app/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlocksSanityChecks.ts:78:15) ... ``` This gets triggered: ```js // Block not in the future, also checks for infinity const currentSlot = chain.clock.currentSlot; if (blockSlot > currentSlot) { throw new BlockError(block, {code: BlockErrorCode.FUTURE_SLOT, blockSlot, currentSlot}); } ``` Or may be this one https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/blob/05c93ba85a4b801c3f220d498e3ddaf45f968536/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlocksSanityChecks.ts#L69 I'm not sure - the line does not match, but error does Btw it has sped up and synchronized! Nethermind<>Lodestar ✅ maybe its a suboptimal peering issue only. nethermind-lodestar ✅ ethereumjs-lodestar ✅ ethereumjs-lighthouse ✅ erigon-lodestar ✅ ethereumjs-prysm ☑️ (syncing) geth-lodestar provisioning That's an ignorable error, this happens when lodestar gets a block range from peer which has one or more missing blocks And then lodestar attempts to download parents by root If everything checks out sync proceeds further We can cal this Multi CL and multi EL already 😆 as soon as we get one more CL working nicely we gonna start up devnet 5 with explorer and everything. Done! Could we add coinbase role to have write access to this channel too? So <@898563924440543283> could also participate here. done! Thanks! thanks <@552133098075193354> I can post now 🙂 We are going to move the Devnet-5 telegram discussion here. <@412614104222531604> can you give us a summary of the clients & client pairs we have currently running? I've lost track! so far this Ah thanks, I guess I should have scrolled up! Nice! Sorry, didn't realize the permissions on this channel were a blocker for this 🤦 ! <@898563924440543283> what should I use for geth init parameters getting ```] Allocated cache and file handles database=/data/geth/chaindata cache=16.00MiB handles=16
INFO [04-25|15:19:53.827] Using LevelDB as the backing database 
INFO [04-25|15:19:53.851] Opened ancient database database=/data/geth/chaindata/ancient/chain readonly=false
INFO [04-25|15:19:53.851] Writing custom genesis block 
Fatal: Failed to write genesis block: unsupported fork ordering: shardingForkTime not enabled, but cancunTime enabled at timestamp 0xc00066a1e0
}``` Hmmm, <@159152274659082240> any ideas? I thought we were going to remove shardingForkTime. Maybe just set it to the same as cancunTime? I can remove it later if that doesn't work. prsym looks synced as well 🎉 ! <@552133098075193354> can you pls also give OP access to this channel? access geth needs to be changed to support cancun. Might as well do that. will do in a sec So now that we have prysm working too, I would like to actually launch devnet 5 tomorrow morning. Would be cool to have geth working too, but I guess we have enough client diversity already to have some good testing going on. geth should be ready after this gets merged: https://github.com/mdehoog/go-ethereum/pull/126 merged
